claim_level_meaning: computational prediction of measured accessibility presence; not biological state, causal mechanism, or external validation

outer_splits.provenance_note: Archival outer folds are disease-stratified donor splits; disease/group/author_cell_type are not model input features. author_cell_type and library are sampling strata only.

inner_splits.rule: label-free sha256('p22-masked-atac-inner-val-v1' + '\n' + donor); first 8 -> inner_val; remaining 16 -> inner_train
inner_splits.note: Same salt/rule as M2 provisional carve; adopted as FROZEN so M2 targets remain valid without re-selection.

sampling.matched_across_arms_note: One global donor×type×library sample; every arm and fold reuses the same per-donor cell IDs

class_dependent_metrics_policy: If a partition lacks both target classes, report secondary class-dependent metrics (AUROC/BA) as unavailable; do not drop donors or targets. Log-loss remains defined.
